_changelog.author: Claude Sonnet 5
_changelog.what: tsconfig for the neurograph OpenClaw extension, scoped to typecheck index.ts and index.test.ts against ambient stub SDK types.
_changelog.why: SOURCE-LIFECYCLE-REPAIR-SPEC.md Extension tests require the extension to type-check against the installed OpenClaw SDK; no real openclaw npm package is installed in this dev environment, so this project resolves the SDK's type surface from types/openclaw-stub.d.ts instead (see that file's header for the exact scope of the stand-in).
_changelog.how: Modeled on jink-mcp/tsconfig.json (Node16 module/resolution, strict, skipLibCheck).
